cases.sentence: Благодарите Господа, потому что Он благ и милость Его ___.
cases.translation: Praise the Lord. Give thanks to the Lord, for he is good; his love endures forever.
cases.explain: Навеки (forever) is an adverb indicating eternal duration.

cases.sentence: Пусть скажут это избавленные им, те, кого Он избавил от руки ___.
cases.translation: Let the redeemed of the Lord say this, those he redeemed from the hand of the foe.
cases.explain: The preposition от (from) always governs the genitive case.

cases.sentence: Он собрал из разных земель, с востока, с запада, с севера и с ___.
cases.translation: He brought them out from the lands, from east and west, from north and south.
cases.explain: The preposition с (from) governs the genitive case.

cases.sentence: Они голодали и жаждали, и томилась их ___.
cases.translation: They hungered and thirsted, and their soul fainted within them.
cases.explain: Душа is the subject of томилась and stands in the nominative case.

cases.sentence: Но воззвали они Господу в своем несчастье, и Он освободил их от ___.
cases.translation: Then they cried to the Lord in their trouble, and he delivered them from their distress.
cases.explain: The preposition от (from) governs the genitive case.

cases.sentence: Они сидели во тьме и в тени смерти, окованные бедствием и ___.
cases.translation: They sat in darkness and in the shadow of death, bound by affliction and iron.
cases.explain: The preposition в (in) with the instrumental indicates the state of being bound with iron.

cases.sentence: Да славят Господа за его милость и за его чудесные дела для ___.
cases.translation: Let them give thanks to the Lord for his unfailing love and his wonderful deeds for mankind.
cases.explain: The preposition для (for) governs the genitive case.

cases.sentence: Повел их прямым путем в город, где они могли ___.
cases.translation: He led them by the right way to a city where they could settle.
cases.explain: The infinitive follows the verb of motion повел expressing purpose.

reading.ru: Благодарите Господа, потому что Он благ и милость Его навеки.
reading.question: Why should people thank the Lord?
options: Because He is good and His mercy lasts forever
Because He is angry and demanding
Because He gives riches to everyone
reading.correct: Because He is good and His mercy lasts forever
reading.explain: The text states 'Благодарите Господа, потому что Он благ и милость Его навеки' (Give thanks to the Lord, for he is good; his love endures forever).

reading.ru: Пусть скажут это избавленные им, те, кого Он избавил от руки врага.
reading.question: Who should declare that the Lord is good?
options: Those redeemed by Him, those He delivered from their enemies
reading.correct: Those redeemed by Him, those He delivered from their enemies
reading.explain: The passage states 'Пусть скажут это избавленные им, те, кого Он избавил от руки врага' (Let the redeemed of the Lord say this, those he redeemed from their enemies).

reading.ru: Блуждали они в пустыне по безлюдным дорогам и не нашли города, в котором могли бы поселиться.
reading.question: What was the people's experience in the wilderness?
options: They wandered and could not find a city to settle in
They built their own cities easily
They refused to travel through the desert
reading.correct: They wandered and could not find a city to settle in
reading.explain: The text says 'Блуждали они в пустыне по безлюдным дорогам и не нашли города' (Some wandered in the wilderness... they found no city to settle in).

reading.ru: Они голодали и жаждали, и томилась их душа, но воззвали они Господу в своем несчастье, и Он освободил их от бедствий.
reading.question: How did God respond to the people's distress in the wilderness?
options: He heard their cry and freed them from hardship
He abandoned them in the desert
reading.correct: He heard their cry and freed them from hardship
reading.explain: The passage states 'воззвали они Господу в своем несчастье, и Он освободил их от бедствий' (they cried out to the Lord... and he delivered them from their distress).

reading.ru: Они сидели во тьме и в тени смерти, окованные бедствием и железом, потому что восстали против слов Божьих.
reading.question: Why were the people held in darkness and bonds?
options: Because they rebelled against God's word
Because they obeyed all God's commands
reading.correct: Because they rebelled against God's word
reading.explain: The text explains 'потому что восстали против слов Божьих' (because they rebelled against the words of God).

reading.ru: Безрассудные страдали за свои грехи и за свое беззаконие, от всякой пищи отвращалась их душа, и они приближались к воротам смерти.
reading.question: What was the consequence of the foolish people's sins?
options: They suffered and drew near to the gates of death
reading.correct: They suffered and drew near to the gates of death
reading.explain: The verse states 'Безрассудные страдали за свои грехи... и они приближались к воротам смерти' (The fools suffered for their transgression... they draw near unto the gates of death).
